responsibilities.quote: Users are responsible for the outputs, actions, and consequences of AI use.
Users should critically evaluate AI outputs for bias, misinformation, or hallucinated data.
All AI outputs must be reviewed by a human before final use in decision-making, publishing, or student evaluation.
The use of AI must comply with all applicable data protection laws and university policies.
Any AI that uses proprietary Grambling State University data or external datasets must undergo a data governance and ethics review.
The University’s Information Technology Center shall provide AI literacy and compliance training to faculty, staff, and students.
The Office of University Compliance will review and update this policy periodically to reflect changes in technology or regulations.
